Film Certification Board Issues Revised Guidelines

The Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) has issued revised guidelines for film certification, the first such update in approximately 35 years. CBFC Chairman Shashi Shekhar Vempati announced the revised guidelines via a post on X, encouraging filmmakers to review and understand the new framework. The guidelines aim to provide a clear structure for the certification process.
